about: WIPER is a fast-paced one-button game.

You are in charge of a wiper and your goal is to clean the windscreen from all the raindrops. The wiper is swinging from side to side and you can swing it from a highlighted side by pressing a button.
The game is over when any raindrop reaches the bottom of the screen.

You can download and play this content on the main PS5 console associated with your account (through the “Console Sharing and Offline Play” setting) and on any other PS5 consoles when you login with your same account.
